defects.description: The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note). In this technical context, 'value' should be translated as 'значение'.
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default). 'Defaults' here refers to 'default values' (значения по умолчанию).
Incorrect grammatical case for the glossary term 'Роль'. It should be in the genitive case ('Роли') to correctly modify 'шаблон запроса'.
